notes.title: 11/19 (Tue) Bug fix - Fixed the problem of freezing after swimming
notes.content:
○Bug fix
-Fixed the problem of Yoohee not being able to control after swimming
-Fixed the terrain where Yoohee couldn't go up properly after swimming

※We received reports of this problem several times and performed 3 updates, but the problem still occurred.
We are very sorry to the users for not noticing it quickly due to our shortcomings.
We thought it was fixed because the bug did not occur during internal testing. 
We completely changed the code structure of the function in this bug fix, so we believe the bug will not occur again.

We would like to thank "-Ch Sbreeze.999" for his great help in finding and fixing the bug.

We will continue to work hard to provide a smoother gameplay in the future.
Thank you for playing.

notes.title: 10/30 (Wed) Hotfix - Fixed the skirt physics of the CatShirt (Yoohee)
notes.content:
- Fixed the UI hide icon in the model view
- Fixed the skirt physics of the CatShirt (Yoohee)

※
We were unable to properly create the shape of the new costume (CatShirt) that was added this time, so there was an issue where the skirt would appear broken when physics were applied.
We worked on the fixes several times to improve the issue,
but in the process, the skirt did not move as well as the previous skirts.
Many users have expressed regret about this,
so we have reverted to the old method because we think users want the skirt to move better rather than the shape of the skirt.
Please understand that we changed the color of the skirt to black to compensate for the broken shape.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused by our shortcomings.
We will continue to work hard.
Thank you for playing.
